> Aratech takes your Speeder Bikes to a whole new level by following your opponents characters whenever they try and run away from you. Along with [[Relentless Tracking]], your opponent's characters will face some serious Force loss unless they choose to either go after your Bike scouts, or just flat out have their characters go on a suicide fight against you. Either way, you win.
